kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ارتعيت (form VIII)
# اِرْتَعَيْتُ (irtaʕaytu) /ir.ta.ʕaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِرْتَعَى (irtaʕā)
# اِرْتَعَيْتَ (irtaʕayta) /ir.ta.ʕaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْتَعَى (irtaʕā)
# اِرْتَعَيْتِ (irtaʕayti) /ir.ta.ʕaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْتَعَى (irtaʕā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
